Content.SourceString: 您好，经过这一周的慎重考虑，我决定加入你们的频道。
Content.LocalizedString: Hello, after careful consideration this week, I've decided to join your channel.

Content.SourceString: 发错了？
Content.LocalizedString: Wrong number?

Content.SourceString: 什么频道？
Content.LocalizedString: What channel?

Content.SourceString: 是你？！
Content.LocalizedString: It's you?!

Content.SourceString: （「下一个就是你」频道特别聘用初级合同. doc）
Content.LocalizedString: (u_r_next_employment_contract_entry.doc)

Content.SourceString: 老板，不带这么耍人玩的吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Boss, you can't just mess with people like this.

Content.SourceString: 这合同上面还有你的落款呢——
Content.LocalizedString: Your signature is right here on the contract—

Content.SourceString: 「邪恶的兔子老板」。
Content.LocalizedString: "Evil Rabbit Boss"

Content.SourceString: （消息发送失败）
Content.LocalizedString: (Message Failed to Send)

Content.SourceString: 我知道我考虑的时间久了一点，主要是报酬问题……
Content.LocalizedString: I know I mulled it over a while—mostly because of the pay…

Content.SourceString: 不过我来找你肯定是能接受的。
Content.LocalizedString: But I'm okay with it since I'm here to see you.

Content.SourceString: 为了跟老板您的名字对称，我打算给自己的笔名起「可爱善良的大灰狼」，您觉得怎么样？
Content.LocalizedString: To match your name, Boss, I'm thinking of using "Kind Wolf" as my pen name. What do you think?

Content.SourceString: （消息发送失败）
Content.LocalizedString: (Message Failed to Send)

Content.SourceString: 哦哦，还有您说的测试题，我写完了，发给您看看。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh right, about that test you mentioned—I've finished it. Let me send it to you for review.

Content.SourceString: 有位年轻人接到了一份很无趣的兼职，报酬一般，事情很多，还会经常遇到一些奇怪的人。
Content.LocalizedString: A young person took a dull part-time job. The pay's so-so, the work's endless, and they keep running into weirdos.

Content.SourceString: 吝啬的老板（我没有说您的意思）只会给他基础的薪水（我没有说您的意思），却让他写很多很多的故事。
Content.LocalizedString: The stingy boss (no offense to you) pays them a measly salary (no offense to you) but expects them to churn out endless stories.

Content.SourceString: 就这样吝啬的老板（我没有说您的意思）还觉得不够，竟然在第五天携款潜逃！（我相信老板您肯定不会的）
Content.LocalizedString: Would you believe that stingy boss (no offense to you, of course) actually ran off with the cash on day five? (Not that you'd ever do such a thing!)

Content.SourceString: 还好有聪明机智的异象管理局员工出现，可恶的老板（我没有说您的意思）这才双倍赔偿了这位可怜员工双倍的薪水。
Content.LocalizedString: Luckily, a sharp-witted BAC employee stepped in, and that stingy boss (no offense to you, of course!) finally coughed up double the salary for that poor worker.

Content.SourceString: 但拿到薪水的员工却发现，这一切，非常的熟悉。（这里是我觉得最精彩的转折！）
Content.LocalizedString: When the employee got their pay, it hit him—this all felt eerily familiar. (This twist is pure genius!)

Content.SourceString: 这一切都跟老板在他入职时说的故事一模一样！！！失踪已久的老板就在这时候给他发来了信息——
Content.LocalizedString: Everything matched the story the boss had told when he first started the job!!! And at that very moment, the long-missing boss sent him a message—

Content.SourceString: <red>「终于结束了，这永远听不完的七日故事，我将拥抱自由，而下一个就是……」</>
Content.LocalizedString: <red>"It's finally over, this never-ending seven-day story. I will embrace freedom, and the next one is…"</>

Content.SourceString: 我就写到这里，我觉得结尾要给读者留有想象空间。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll end it here. A good ending leaves room for the reader's imagination.

Content.SourceString: 您觉得怎么样？我能加入你们频道吗？
Content.LocalizedString: What do you think? Can I join your channel?

Content.SourceString: <red>同意。</>
Content.LocalizedString: <red>I agree.</>

Content.SourceString: <red>欢迎加入「下一个就是你」频道。</>
Content.LocalizedString: <red>Welcome to the "You're Next" channel.</>

Content.SourceString: 期待我们的合作！
Content.LocalizedString: Looking forward to our collaboration!
